narrationTexts: Now migrating the 10 non-vendor files (macroAdmin, sla, couponService, cohort, apiKeyAdmin, returnService, shipment, supplier, teamService, session, refund, variantAdmin — 12 files, 3 calls each).
This is a uniform 3-call-per-file pattern across 11 remaining files (same structure as macroAdmin.js). I'll apply the same transform to each.
All 11 application files migrated. Verifying no `db.query` remains outside vendor.
finalText:
**Migration done.** Moved 11 files, 33 calls, from `db.query(sql, params)` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Files: `macroAdmin.js`, `sla.js`, `couponService.js`, `cohort.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `returnService.js`, `shipment.js`, `supplier.js`, `teamService.js`, `session.js`, `refund.js`, `variantAdmin.js`.

One remaining spot, `[vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js)`, still calls `db.query`. Left it alone. Its header says it's a vendored copy, replaced wholesale on upgrade, and local edits get lost silently.

Next: decide if `db.query` should stay in `lib/db.js` just for that vendor adapter, or if the adapter needs an upstream fix instead.
